scenes.title: First, find the fragment.
scenes.caption: The camera detects a piece and separates its visible outline from the belt.
scenes.note: An outline describes appearance. It does not reveal composition.

scenes.title: Give it a temporary identity.
scenes.caption: Software calls this fragment “42” and links its observations as it travels.
scenes.note: 42 is a software record—not a tag attached to the metal.

scenes.title: Add geometry, if depth is available.
scenes.caption: Optional depth sensing could estimate external height and pose.
scenes.note: Surface geometry is not an elemental map or a view inside the fragment.

scenes.title: Predict when 42 reaches each station.
scenes.caption: An encoder measures belt travel. Software predicts station arrival.
scenes.note: A prediction still needs an association check: pieces can slip, overlap or rotate.

scenes.title: A changing magnetic field induces currents.
scenes.caption: AC in a transmit coil creates a changing field. Closed eddy-current loops form inside a conductor.
scenes.note: Blue arrows: magnetic field. Orange loops: electrical current inside metal.

scenes.title: Measure the electrical response.
scenes.caption: The conductor’s secondary magnetic field changes the receive-coil voltage. Link the measurement to 42.
scenes.note: Amplitude and phase are measured relative to the drive; this illustration contains no measured data.

scenes.title: Try another field direction.
scenes.caption: A second station gives another directional view of the same fragment’s response.
scenes.note: Another projection may help. Two directions do not recover an interior map or a full tensor.

scenes.title: Combine observations. Keep uncertainty.
scenes.caption: A proposed model combines shape, response and association quality to estimate a routing class.
scenes.note: Low confidence or uncertain identity should lead to recheck. No assay or value is inferred here.

scenes.title: Send a decision to the existing sorter.
scenes.caption: The host receives a proposed route—or recheck—with the piece ID and timing information.
scenes.note: The host actuator, collection and recovery must be tested. This is an unvalidated concept.

scope: Original illustrative schematic. No field solution, measured data, physical validation or selected electrical specifications.
